blockingFindings: Successor implementation lacks a defined admission route. In openspec/sprints/sprints.json, SP02/SP03/SP07/SP08 have empty stages, while openspec/moriarty-completion-program.json makes stageAdmission authoritative for preparation and execution. atomic-prepare covers the existing atomic correction; rp01-full covers design only; finance waits for composition and mandatory acceptance. Yet SP09 mandatory promotion requires the successor inputs produced by these earlier sprints. Add explicit preparation stages and campaign ownership for successor frontend/K/financial implementation, independent of downstream acceptance. Otherwise implementers must bypass admission or introduce a hidden dependency cycle.

SP02's simulation exit depends on work assigned to SP03. openspec/sprints/sp02-complete-mori-authoring-frontend.md SP02.3 requires a working successor simulation CLI showing effects, duties and work, but openspec/sprints/sp03-executable-bounded-semantics-in-k.md assigns creation of src/successor/evaluate.ts to SP03, which requires SP02 completion. Assign a minimal successor evaluator to SP02, or move simulation acceptance to SP03 and make the prerequisite frontend-only. Reusing the atomic evaluator without an explicit semantic bridge would implement the wrong update semantics.
nonblockingFindings: openspec/sprints/coverage.json maps requirements broadly to package-associated sprints rather than specific closure tasks. Explicitly map MC04 P.1-P.7 and adapter-profile-01 to SP09 tasks: SP09.1 names the fixed SP06 proof, while SP09.5 names the mandatory campaign. The retained MC04 contract preserves the required loan/swap extension, but its sprint placement is easy to miss.

openspec/changes/mc04-ledger-correspondence-and-consumption/tasks.md 3.2 still mandates running Lean despite the new K-first verification contract. Reconcile that instruction with openspec/sprints/README.md so supporting Lean work is required only by a justified proof bridge.
acceptedScope: The delivery-contract approach is appropriate, and SP01.1 provides a concrete inspect/check/reconcile first step. Coverage preserves financial inventories, held-outs, intent cases and composition operators. The plan responsibly separates native finalizer feasibility from financial proving and retains versioned requalification, durable authority, privacy isolation, actual ledger acceptance, independent evidence and bounded resource gates. Deferring source-dependent executable packets is appropriate.
limits: Reviewed supplied text only; no repository validation, hash recomputation, runtime checks or external evidence inspection. No other auditor verdict was consulted. This assessment concerns planning consistency, not implementation feasibility, theorem validity, campaign admission, package completion or product acceptance.
